about: Tenant harbor's rooms and Night rates (centavos), for the eval battery's rt-* cases (plan/booking-types.md Phase 6). Loaded by plan/booking-types-phase6-harbor.mjs, which upserts by name, so it is safe to run again. Garden Room and Family Room match what the Phase 4 walk created. The Old Annex is inactive but priced, so rt-inactive proves the tool leaves it out because it is retired, not because it has no rate. Extra guests (plan/extra-guests.md): every room covers 2 guests in its rate and charges 25000 centavos (PHP 250) per guest above that, up to its own maximum, which is unchanged.
